about.headline: Design that drives results.
paragraphs: I'm a graphic designer who knows marketing from the inside. I set up and optimize Meta Ads campaigns myself, run social media, and as co-founder of Doin Digital I see which creatives really work. That's why I design with results in mind, not just looks.

I use AI to automate repetitive tasks and deliver more, faster. I'm independent, well organized and clear in communication, and I test new tools with curiosity. I want to keep growing in marketing, combining design with data.
